name: Mirai no Kuni kara Nakadashi Motomete Harubaru to
original_name: 未来の国から中出し求めてはるばると
source:
The main character is a man no less than ordinary mediocre. However, he gets visit of a nekomimi robot from 22th century named Torae and start living with it/her!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE053707.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公只是个再平凡不过的普通男人。然而，来自22世纪的猫耳机器人虎惠突然造访，从此与他开始共同生活！

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE053707.html]DLsite English[/url]]
